name: citation-management
description:
Creates citation organization systems and format guides for learners managing academic sources. Produces a citation management plan with format examples for the learner's chosen style (APA, MLA, Chicago) -- not a citation generator.
Use when a learner asks to organize their citations, set up a citation system, understand citation formats, or manage references for a research paper.
Do NOT use for evaluating sources (use `source-evaluation`), for finding sources (use `literature-search`), or for writing annotated bibliographies (use `annotated-bibliography`).
